list.name: min_contract_value
list.label: Min contract value (€)
list.description: Minimum contract value filter. A panel only counts a contract when |preço contratual| is greater than or equal to this amount, in euros. The loaded data already leaves out contracts below €10 (the is_below_min_value ingest rule, MIN_VALUE in src/base_gov/stats.py), so 0 and 10 give the same result. €5 000 / €20 000 / €75 000 are the informal reference points used in the notebooks — they are NOT legal CCP thresholds. The absolute value is used, because negative prices occur in the source data.

options.content:
**Caveats (from the notebooks)**

- `Ano` covers 2025–2026 only; the first and last months of any monthly series are partial.
- A multi-awardee contract counts in full for each awardee in every supplier total.
- Entities are keyed by NIPC; `-` (no NIF) entries are clustered by name similarity (`token_sort_ratio >= 92`) and may over- or under-merge.
- The Município rule gives 309 NIPC vs 308 real municipalities — at least one false positive; `Câmara Municipal …` names are deliberately excluded.
- Very large values may be outliers or data-entry errors.
- `valor_por_dia` is defined only for 1–3650-day durations.

panels.title: Procedure family — share of count vs share of value

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.procedure_family AS family, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS "share of count (%)", round(100.0 * sum(v.preco_contratual) / nullif(sum(sum(v.preco_contratual)) OVER (), 0), 1) AS "share of value (%)" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND v.is_municipio GROUP BY v.procedure_family ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Notebook conclusion (procedures_comparison): Ajuste Direto is most contracts by count but a small share of value; Concurso Público is the reverse.

panels.title: Price level by procedure family

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.procedure_family AS family, count(*) AS contracts, (percentile_cont(ARRAY[0.5, 0.9, 0.99]) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.preco_contratual))[1] AS median, (percentile_cont(ARRAY[0.5, 0.9, 0.99]) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.preco_contratual))[2] AS p90, (percentile_cont(ARRAY[0.5, 0.9, 0.99]) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.preco_contratual))[3] AS p99 FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND v.is_municipio GROUP BY v.procedure_family ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Median, 90th and 99th percentile of preço contratual per procedure family.

panels.title: Duration and €/day by procedure family

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.procedure_family AS family, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.prazo_execucao) AS "median prazo (days)", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.valor_por_dia) AS "median €/day" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND v.is_municipio GROUP BY v.procedure_family ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Median prazo_execucao and valor_por_dia (defined only for 1–3650-day durations).

panels.title: Median €/day by duration bucket

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.duration_bucket AS bucket, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.valor_por_dia) AS "median €/day" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND v.is_municipio AND v.duration_bucket IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.duration_bucket ORDER BY min(v.prazo_execucao)

panels.description: Short contracts inflate €/day: the shorter the duration, the higher the daily value.

panels.title: Contract value distribution (informal reference bands)

targets.rawSql: SELECT band, count(*) AS contracts FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 1000 THEN '1) < 1k' WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 5000 THEN '2) 1k–5k' WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 20000 THEN '3) 5k–20k' WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 75000 THEN '4) 20k–75k' WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 250000 THEN '5) 75k–250k' ELSE '6) ≥ 250k' END AS band FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND v.is_municipio) t GROUP BY band ORDER BY band

panels.description: Band edges at €5 000 / €20 000 / €75 000 are the informal reference points used in the notebooks (ajuste_direto_contracts) — NOT legal CCP thresholds.

panels.title: Bidders: reported share and single-bidder share

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.n_concorrentes IS NOT NULL) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS "reported (% of contracts)", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.n_concorrentes = 1) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.n_concorrentes IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS "single bidder (% of reported)" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND v.is_municipio

panels.description: The single-bidder share denominator is contracts with a reported number of bidders only; concorrentes is null for over half of contracts.

panels.title: Lifecycle: closed share and Σ efetivo − Σ contratual

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.closed_at IS NOT NULL) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS "closed (% of contracts)", coalesce(sum(v.preco_total_efetivo - v.preco_contratual) FILTER (WHERE v.preco_total_efetivo IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "Σ efetivo − Σ contratual (closed)" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND v.is_municipio

panels.description: Lower bound as of the export date: data_fecho and preco_total_efetivo only populate when a contract is closed.

panels.title: Buyer concentration by family (top-10 share, HHI)

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT v.procedure_family AS family, v.adjudicante_id, sum(v.preco_contratual) AS val FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND v.is_municipio GROUP BY 1, 2), t AS (SELECT family, val / nullif(sum(val) OVER (PARTITION BY family), 0) AS share, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY family ORDER BY val DESC) AS rn FROM s) SELECT family, count(*) AS buyers, round(100 * sum(share) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 10), 1) AS "top-10 share (%)", round(sum(share * share)::numeric, 4) AS hhi FROM t GROUP BY family ORDER BY family

panels.description: Share of value held by the 10 largest buyers per procedure family, and the Herfindahl–Hirschman index (0 = fragmented, 1 = one buyer).

panels.title: Supplier concentration by family

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT v.procedure_family AS family, v.adjudicatario_id, sum(v.preco_contratual) AS val FROM procurement.v_adjudicatario_contracts v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ','))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND v.is_municipio GROUP BY 1, 2), t AS (SELECT family, val / nullif(sum(val) OVER (PARTITION BY family), 0) AS share, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY family ORDER BY val DESC) AS rn FROM s) SELECT family, count(*) AS suppliers, round(100 * sum(share) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 10), 1) AS "top-10 share (%)", round(sum(share * share)::numeric, 4) AS hhi FROM t GROUP BY family ORDER BY family

panels.description: A multi-awardee contract counts in full for each awardee, so supplier shares are not additive to the contract total.

panels.title: Ajuste Direto share — by count vs by value

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.procedure_family = 'ajuste_direto') / nullif(count(*), 0) AS "by count", 100.0 * sum(v.preco_contratual) FILTER (WHERE v.procedure_family = 'ajuste_direto') / nullif(sum(v.preco_contratual), 0) AS "by value" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND v.is_municipio

panels.description: municipio_vs_ajuste_direto: direct award is about half of municipal contracts by count but about an eighth by value.

panels.title: AD share by município (≥ 50 contracts)

targets.rawSql: WITH m AS (SELECT v.adjudicante_id, min(v.adjudicante_name) AS municipio, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.procedure_family = 'ajuste_direto') / count(*), 1) AS ad_share_pct FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND v.is_municipio GROUP BY v.adjudicante_id HAVING count(*) >= 50), r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ad_share_pct DESC) AS rk_desc, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ad_share_pct ASC) AS rk_asc FROM m) SELECT municipio, ad_share_pct FROM r WHERE rk_desc <= 10 OR rk_asc <= 10 ORDER BY ad_share_pct DESC

panels.description: Top and bottom 10 municipalities by direct-award share, among those with at least 50 contracts in the selected range. Keyed by NIPC, so each entity counts once.
